scenario.title: BATTLE OF VORONEZH - 28 JUN 1942
intro.text:
BATTLE OF VORONEZH - 28 JUN 1942

Volovo, Northwest of Voronezh

The Germans launch an offensive towards Voronezh. Strong forces are trying to break through our defensive positions. Delay the advance of the fascists until we bring up reserves to defense the city!

ORDERS
After 10 turns control 8/7/5 VH for a BV/V/TV.

CORE (recommended)
4x Tank
5x Infantry
2x Anti-Tank
2x Reconnaissance
2x Flak (+1)
4x Artillery
3x Fighter Aircraft (+1)
2x Tactical Bomber
header.act: ACT III — FROM DEFEAT TO OPERATIONAL MASTERY
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.reaction-briliant.text: The northern pincer met every assigned target at Kharkov. The southern disaster still swallowed the operation, proving that a flawless part cannot rescue a false whole.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.reaction-victory.text: Our formations fought out of the Kharkov operation in order. The map arrows did not meet; the German reserves did.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.reaction-tactical.text: Kharkov ended with the force barely extracted and the warning estimates confirmed by events. Nobody at headquarters has asked to see them again.
line.reaction-lose.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.reaction-lose.text: The Kharkov offensive collapsed before our group completed its assigned losses. The enemy reserves from my annex are now moving toward Voronezh, and the formations sent to stop them are still escaping the last map.
line.callback-choice-a.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.callback-choice-a.text: At Kharkov you accepted the timetable after I placed the reserve estimates on your desk. I have brought no new warning today—only the unit numbers that survived our disbelief.
line.callback-choice-b.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.callback-choice-b.text: The reserve you held at Kharkov could not rescue the whole offensive, but it brought organised formations out of the salient. Some of the men digging outside are alive because you believed an uncertain report.
line.earned-decision.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.earned-decision.text: The mobile reserve you withheld at Kharkov survived the retreat as a formed group. Headquarters has not yet decided where to send it, which gives us one hour to decide first.
line.earned-decision.choice.form-reserve: Turn the surviving reserve scouts into a permanent reconnaissance detachment.
Add an experienced eight-strength reconnaissance-infantry detachment to the core.
line.earned-decision.choice.return-reser: Return its crews and vehicles to reinforce the mobile core.
Give tanks and reconnaissance formations 18 experience and fully refuel the core.
line.earned-a-response.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.earned-a-response.text: I will give them the unit numbers from my estimates. They have already met most of those formations once.
line.earned-b-response.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.earned-b-response.text: No ceremonial new unit, then. The experienced drivers go where replacement tables currently show only a number.
line.scene-0.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.scene-0.text: Men from Kharkov dig beside units that have never heard a shot. The trenches are shallow because the order to hold this line arrived after the enemy columns were already moving.
line.scene-1.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.scene-1.text: The formations reported north of Kharkov did not vanish when our offensive did. Their columns are on these roads now. Intelligence has changed from a warning into the enemy's order of march.
line.decision.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.decision.text: We can build fixed strongpoints around the objectives, or use a mobile reserve to trade ground for time and counterattack exposed spearheads. Neither method creates the reserves we are waiting for.
line.decision.choice.mobile-defence.text: Keep armour mobile and counterattack only where an enemy spearhead outruns its support.
line.decision.choice.mobile-defence.hint: Fully refuel the core and give tanks and reconnaissance formations 25 experience each for mobile counterattack drills.
line.decision.choice.anchor-the-line.tex: Fortify the objective belt and force every German column to deploy against it.
line.decision.choice.anchor-the-line.hin: Restore the core to at least nine strength with full ammunition and give infantry 20 experience; fuel remains unchanged.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.choice-a-0.text: The reserve receives fuel priority and no sector owns it. A local commander may request help; only the army commander releases it.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.choice-a-1.text: Release conditions go to every sector before the reserve moves. No local commander keeps it because his own trench is the one he can see.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.choice-b-0.text: Every strongpoint stores ammunition before the battle and marks a fallback route before it is needed. Holding does not mean being surprised in place.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.choice-b-1.text: Then my tanks become concrete that can still burn. Mark the fallback roads now; I will not dig crews into positions their machines cannot leave.
line.post-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.post-0.text: Mark the reserve conditions and the fallback roads in the same ink. I want neither invented after the first penetration.
